description: Zando vendors’ February 2 activity remains a discovery lead. description: S021’s search result identifies a possible Beni university-staff strike lead. Its prior body synopsis, including the claimed February 2 effective strike, campus general assembly and external-audit demand, lacks a contemporaneous saved manual-review note and is quarantined as non-evidence. Occurrence, event date, publicness, state-policy target, attendance threshold, strike continuity and state response remain unresolved; do not infer these facts from the preserved body synopsis.

notes: S021’s body-read flag and old synopsis are historical process records only. The search lead remains discovery metadata; the body claims are not operative evidence. No public gathering is inferred.

description: Actu30’s body establishes a public ECIDE march in Kananga on February 10, 2021 over insecurity and demands for local officials to resign and governor elections. Police stopped it at the starting-point roundabout, arrested the ECIDE federation chair and two militants, while other participants fled. The crowd size is not reported, and three arrests do not establish the >=50 threshold. Coulisses S011 appears to describe a similar Kananga/Fayulu march, but no body or written origin link establishes whether it covers the same action. Q024 also surfaced search-only S036 and S037: S036 announces the Feb 10 ECIDE action and S037 lists a 7sur7 account; both may concern this same action and do not establish an additional event.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous account with an attendance estimate and compare the Coulisses report’s event date, details, and any explicit source attribution before merging or treating it as independent.
notes: S010 was read after web.open returned only a technical cache miss, using ordinary public HTTPS with a separate fresh receipt and manual review. No denied HTTP status occurred. It is a candidate with pending_threshold; arrest numbers are not used as crowd size.

description: Infocongo confirms a peaceful Kananga march by judicial defenders on February 25 against a new bar law and reports that the provincial assembly quaestor received their memo and promised to forward it. Turnout is unreported. A Radio Okapi archive lists a matching headline/date, but no direct story URL or origin relation establishes whether it is the same report or an independent account.
required_followup: Find an attendance estimate and a direct Radio Okapi article or origin note; do not count the archive listing as independent confirmation. Check whether the memorandum was forwarded or acted on.
notes: The memo receipt and promise to forward are coded as accommodation limited to procedural receipt; they are not coded as a law change or victory.

description: InfosLive body confirms a Lucha street protest in Kananga against rising insecurity and demanding the local mayor’s resignation. The article says “this Friday”; its URL path is dated 12 February, but no separate absolute occurrence timestamp or turnout is given. S013 Afrique Media’s search lead describes a civil-society insecurity protest around February 13 and may refer to the same action or the separately announced civic-forces march; no body or origin relation resolves this.
required_followup: Seek an accessible contemporaneous account with a numeric attendance estimate and explicit event date, and establish whether S013 is the Lucha action, the planned civic-forces march, a separate action, or a related copy. Do not count the announced civic-forces march as executed without evidence.
notes: The demand to the Kananga mayor is explicit and is recorded in E006 field evidence; the attendance threshold remains unresolved. Police repression reported for the separate Feb 10 ECIDE action is not coded as a response to Lucha.
